title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August; unemployment 4.1%, information sector sheds 23,000
summary: August payrolls beat estimates; the information industry lost 23,000 jobs, continuing a downtrend.
reason: Strong headline labour data counters AI-displacement fears; info-sector losses noted.

title: MBZUAI releases K2 Horizon, six fully open models up to 375B
summary: Abu Dhabi's MBZUAI released Apache-2.0 models from 0.9B to 375B parameters with weights, code, data and methods.
reason: Fully open release from the Gulf; below frontier.

title: DeepSeek plans 160,000 Huawei Ascend chips at 1GW Inner Mongolia site
summary: Bloomberg reported DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT accelerators for inference at a 1GW Ulanqab data centre by late 2027 or early 2028.
reason: Plan for domestic-chip compute scale in China.

title: Nvidia model beats top human at IOI 2026 in preprint
summary: Nvidia reported its Nemotron-3-Ultra model scored 535.4/600 at the International Olympiad in Informatics, above the top human's 498.27.

title: Kurzweil joins nasal-spray BCI startup Subsense
summary: Ray Kurzweil became an adviser to Subsense, a preclinical non-surgical BCI startup that has raised $27M and is testing in mice.

title: NHTSA opens probe into Tesla Cybercabs running without steering wheels
summary: Regulators opened an investigation after production Cybercabs entered Austin service without steering wheels or pedals.
reason: Oversight of autonomous systems in transport.
